verdict.rationale: There is no documented in-product natural-language command interface for operating Bitbucket. The adjacent signals are Rovo model access in the terminal and IDE (docs-5), AI-powered pipeline workflows (docs-4), and an official Atlassian MCP server that could let an external agent drive the product from natural-language prompts (probe-4). The evidence never ties these explicitly to natural-language control of Bitbucket repos, PRs or settings. Missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in Bitbucket, documentation of the Bitbucket actions Rovo or the MCP server can perform, hands-on or independent corroboration.
